void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, deepest background layer — absorbs everything below the fold

carbon.$description: Carbon — Card surfaces, terminal mockup backgrounds, badge fill

graphite.$description: Graphite — Elevated surface, nested panel backgrounds, subtle border against carbon

slate-base.$description: Slate Base — Dominant neutral — body text borders, hairlines, icon strokes, grid line color (appears 5,900+ times as borderColor)

fog.$description: Fog — Muted body text, secondary labels, disabled helper text

steel.$description: Steel — Tertiary text, icon outlines, inactive nav items

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary text, link text at rest, footer copy

silver.$description: Silver — Primary UI text, nav items, body copy at default weight

bone.$description: Bone — Headline color, high-emphasis text, display copy — the lightest ink in the system

phosphor-green.$description: Phosphor Green — Green accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Filled CTA background, button fill, badge background — the only chromatic fill in the interface, reserved for primary action surfaces

emerald-depth.$description: Emerald Depth — Hover/active state for deep teal surfaces, decorative green wash in body copy contexts, large-area green-tinted backgrounds

diagnostic-magenta.$description: Diagnostic Magenta — Red text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

syntax-violet.$description: Syntax Violet — Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

syntax-coral.$description: Syntax Coral — Red text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

syntax-forest.$description: Syntax Forest — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

suisseintl.$description: Primary interface typeface — body copy, headlines, nav items, hero text, footer. Weight 400 is the only weight used, which forces typographic hierarchy to come from size and tracking rather than bold weight. Display sizes (50–65px) use negative tracking (-0.005em to -0.003em) to tighten the headlines; small sizes (11–12px) use positive tracking (0.044–0.053em) to open up labels.

gt-america-mono.$description: Technical labels, tab names (CLI, API, CONSOLE), badge text, button labels, nav annotations, code blocks, metadata. Wide positive tracking (0.014–0.064em) at all sizes gives the typeface a 'system readout' quality. The 'calt' 0 setting deliberately disables contextual alternates so the monospace grid stays rigid — this is mono as system chrome, not mono as code.
